review_candidates.title: SENIOR AP ACCOUNTANT
review_candidates.description: BRAND AID GROUP JOB DESCRIPTION — SENIOR AP ACCOUNTANT Egypt | Allocation: Egypt & GCC 1. Position Overview Position: Senior AP Accountant Physical Location: Egypt Allocation: Egypt & GCC Coverage / Scope: Egypt AP and GCC AP, and that will be based in Egypt Job family: Accounts Payable / Procure-to-Pay. This role is responsible for ensuring complete, accurate, timely and controlled accounting activities across the stated coverage, with clear ownership of local statutory requirements and Group reporting requirements. 2. Role Purpose Manage the complete AP cycle across Egypt & GCC, ensuring accurate invoice processing, supplier reconciliations, compliant tax treatment, controlled payment readiness and reliable period-end cut-off. 3. Geographic and Organizational Coverage ·       Primary physical base: Egypt. ·       Formal allocation: Egypt & GCC. ·       Required coverage: Egypt AP and GCC AP, and that will be based in Egypt. ·       Where the role has regional coverage, the incumbent must operate consistently across entities and coordinate with local teams while respecting country-specific statutory and banking requirements. ·       The role must maintain standardized accounting processes, documentation and reporting while escalating country-specific exceptions to the relevant Chief Accountant / Finance leadership. 4. Key Responsibilities ·       Own end-to-end AP accounting for assigned entities, from invoice validation and posting through vendor reconciliation and payment preparation. ·       Validate supplier invoices against purchase orders, goods/services receipt evidence, contracts and approval requirements. ·       Process invoices, credit/debit notes, advances, retentions and other supplier transactions accurately and on time. ·       Perform vendor statement reconciliations and resolve unmatched invoices, duplicate invoices, blocked items and aged balances. ·       Maintain AP ageing and payment due-date reports and coordinate payment priorities with Treasury and management. ·       Support GRNI/accruals, expense accruals, prepayments and cut-off procedures at month-end. ·       Ensure correct tax/VAT/WHT treatment and supporting documentation in accordance with local requirements. ·       Support intercompany AP activities, confirmations and settlement processes where applicable. ·       Maintain vendor master-data controls and segregation of duties in coordination with Procurement and system administrators. ·       Support month-end close, audit requests and AP process improvement/automation. ·       Review work prepared by junior accountants within the assigned process and provide technical guidance and quality control. ·       Act as a key escalation point for complex reconciliations, unusual transactions and cross-functional accounting issues. 5. Month-End, Quarter-End and Year-End Close ·       Follow the approved close calendar and submit all assigned schedules, journals and reconciliations within deadlines. ·       Ensure proper cut-off for revenue, costs, AP, AR, payroll, inventory/WIP, accruals, prepayments and other balance-sheet items as applicable. ·       Investigate unusual balances and material movements and provide clear explanations. ·       Maintain audit-ready working papers and evidence for all material balances and adjustments. ·       Support management reporting and external/statutory reporting requirements. 6. IFRS, Accounting Policy and Compliance ·       Apply Group accounting policies and relevant IFRS requirements consistently. ·       Support IFRS revenue recognition and project accounting where applicable, including contract assets/liabilities, billing versus revenue, WIP and percentage-of-completion inputs. ·       Apply appropriate treatment for provisions, expected credit losses, leases, foreign exchange, inventory/WIP, fixed assets and intercompany balances as relevant to the role. ·       Maintain evidence of local tax/VAT/WHT/e-invoicing compliance and coordinate with tax specialists/advisers where required. ·       Escalate non-routine or material accounting judgments to the Chief Accountant / Group Finance leadership. 7. ERP, Data and Automation ·       Use Odoo/ERP as the system of record and maintain accurate dimensions, projects, cost centers, analytic accounts and master data within the role's authority. ·       Ensure transaction processing is supported by approved source documents and follows segregation-of-duties requirements. ·       Use Excel and, where available, Power Query/Power Pivot/Tableau  or reporting tools to automate reconciliations and recurring reports. ·       Identify manual, duplicate or error-prone activities and propose system/process automation. ·       Participate in ERP testing, UAT, master-data governance and process improvements affecting the accounting function. 8. Internal Controls and Risk Management ·       Comply with approval matrices, segregation of duties, access controls and documented accounting procedures. ·       Maintain complete supporting documentation and an audit trail for all transactions and adjustments. ·       Identify control failures, unusual transactions, duplicate payments, unsupported balances or potential fraud indicators and escalate immediately. ·       Support internal and external audits and close audit findings within agreed timelines. ·       Protect financial information and maintain confidentiality. 9. Key Stakeholder Interfaces ·       Chief Accountant / Finance leadership ·       GL, AR, AP, Treasury and Cost Control teams ·       Operations and Project Management ·       Commercial / Sales ·       Procurement and Supply Chain ·       HR / Payroll ·       Tax / Legal / Compliance ·       External auditors and professional advisers ·       Banks and payment service providers ·       ERP / IT / Data teams ·       Country management and Group Finance 10. Decision Rights and Escalation ·       Operate within the approved delegation of authority and accounting policies. ·       Approve/review transactions only to the extent permitted by the formal approval matrix. ·       Escalate material, unusual, disputed, high-risk or policy-sensitive transactions to the appropriate finance leader. ·       Do not bypass segregation of duties or create unsupported manual adjustments. ·       For regional roles, resolve operational matters locally where possible and escalate cross-country issues that could affect consolidated reporting, cash, tax or compliance. 11. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) ·       Invoice processing timeliness and accuracy ·       AP ageing and overdue items ·       Vendor reconciliation completion ·       Duplicate/error rate ·       Payment readiness and on-time payment support ·       GRNI/accrual accuracy 12. Qualifications and Experience ·       Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline. ·       Professional accounting Certification (IFRS) is an advantage. ·       Strong knowledge of double-entry accounting, month-end close, reconciliations, financial reporting and internal controls. ·       Strong Excel skills; experience with Power Query/Power Pivot/Tableau  and ERP systems such as Odoo or SAP is highly desirable. ·       Ability to work with multi-entity, multi-currency environments and maintain disciplined supporting documentation. ·       Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills. ·       Fluent professional English; Arabic is a MUST. ·       Typically 5–8+ years of relevant accounting experience. ·       Prior experience in a multi-entity, projects/services or regional environment is preferred. 13. Behavioral and Technical Competencies ·       Accuracy and attention to detail ·       Ownership and accountability ·       IFRS and accounting-policy application ·       Reconciliation and analytical skills ·       Process discipline and internal control mindset ·       ERP and data literacy ·       Communication and stakeholder management ·       Deadline management and ability to operate under month-end pressure ·       Continuous improvement and automation mindset 14. Role Success Profile A successful incumbent will deliver reliable numbers, clean reconciliations, strong documentation, disciplined controls and timely reporting. For regional positions, success additionally requires consistent cross-country processes, proactive communication, strong ownership of remote stakeholders and the ability to distinguish Group requirements from country-specific statutory requirements. 15. Important Scope Note This Job Description defines the intended operating scope at the time of hiring. Specific legal-entity, banking, tax, statutory-signatory and approval responsibilities remain subject to the applicable delegation of authority, local law, Group policies and final organizational design.

review_candidates.description: FidelyA is at a genuinely early stage. The SaaS is not fully built yet, and we are looking for someone senior enough to help turn a clear commercial vision into the practical technical work needed to make it real. We are building software that helps businesses identify employee friction and improve performance, engagement and behaviour through insight, incentives, recommendations and automation. This is an AI-native engineering role. Development is done using AI: we need someone who is already highly effective with Claude Code and knows how to use it responsibly to turn a clear specification into high-quality, maintainable production software. THE ROLE You will help shape and build FidelyA’s foundations across platform architecture, data, automation, integrations and applied AI. You will work closely with the founder and CTO. Often, the starting point will be a desired outcome, a conversation or a rough idea—not a fully written backlog. You need to be able to turn that into a sensible specification, a practical plan and working software. We do not want unnecessary process, ceremony or ticket management. We want someone with good judgement, a positive attitude and enough initiative to move work forward without hand-holding. WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON • Designing the core platform and multi-tenant SaaS foundations • Creating clean, scalable data models, database schemas and APIs • Building integrations, workflows and operational automations • Developing alerts, reporting, recommendations and practical AI-assisted operations • Deciding what belongs in the database, backend, automation layer or AI workflow • Establishing sensible patterns for permissions, auditability and reliability • Reducing manual work across onboarding, operations, reporting and incentives • Mentoring a junior developer through clear specifications, code review and hands-on guidance WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU You are a senior, hands-on engineer with strong technical judgement and a proven ability to build with AI. Essentially, you should: • Be genuinely expert with Claude Code or an equivalent AI-native development workflow • Have used spec-driven development in practice: turning outcomes into clear requirements, acceptance criteria and executable engineering work • Know how to use AI to accelerate delivery without compromising architecture, security, testing or maintainability • Be comfortable reviewing, challenging and improving AI-generated code rather than accepting it blindly • Have strong backend engineering, SQL and PostgreSQL experience • Be confident designing production-grade schemas, APIs, integrations and automated systems • Be able to translate business needs into practical technical tasks independently • Be comfortable in a zero-to-one environment where priorities will evolve • Communicate clearly, document key decisions and mentor a junior developer • Bring a pragmatic, calm and constructive attitude Experience with Supabase, multi-tenant SaaS, TypeScript, Python, AI/LLM workflows, alerts, analytics or recommendation systems would be valuable, but sound judgement and execution matter more than ticking every technology box. Our current environment includes TypeScript, React, Supabase/PostgreSQL, GitHub and AI-native development workflows. You do not need to be an expert in every tool from day one, but you must be able to understand an existing codebase, make sound architectural decisions and ship reliable production software. THIS PROBABLY ISN’T FOR YOU IF • You need every task fully specified before you can begin • You want a traditional, ticket-led engineering environment • You prefer process and planning to building and solving problems • You cannot confidently turn an ambiguous request into a clear, testable specification • You are not already highly capable using AI tools such as Claude Code as part of daily development • You expect hand-holding, constant direction or an established team and product around you • You are interested in AI demos, but not reliable systems that improve real operations WORKING ARRANGEMENT • Full-time engagement, with an initial commitment of at least six months • Fully remote role for someone based in Poland • Direct work with the founder and CTO • Close collaboration with a junior developer • Start as soon as possible This is a chance to have genuine influence while the company’s technical foundations are still being formed. The work will be broad, practical and sometimes messy—as early-stage building often is—but it will directly shape the product, the business and how FidelyA scales.
